customer_job.persona: Pennsylvania procurement analyst reviewing a newly submitted vendor before onboarding
customer_job.trigger: A vendor requests approval and the analyst must decide whether to escalate for review
customer_job.success_action: Open a reviewer-ready evidence brief with clear source-specific findings and next actions
customer_job.consequence_of_failure: An ambiguous name or source failure is incorrectly treated as permission to proceed

comparator.method: Manual separate Pennsylvania registry, OFAC SDN, and authoritative RDAP queries plus analyst consolidation

improvement.proposed_change: Prototype an evidence-linked reviewer brief with explicit uncertainty, missing-source flags, and action codes while preserving human_review boundaries
improvement.expected_benefit: Reduce repeated source lookup and escalation ambiguity without increasing incorrect automatic proceed decisions

blind_evaluation.acceptance_rule: Record baseline task time and error counts blind; require zero incorrect proceed verdicts on every deliberately blocked fixture before review.

customer_job.persona: Local procurement analyst screening a legal registered address against a radius rule
customer_job.trigger: A new vendor is compared against a geographic registered-address rule before human procurement review
customer_job.success_action: Receive auditable coordinate evidence, explicit distance units, and referral when geocoding is inconclusive
customer_job.consequence_of_failure: A registered address is misrepresented as an operating site or straight-line distance as actual travel time

comparator.method: Manual Pennsylvania registry lookup followed by Census geocoding and separate great-circle distance calculation

improvement.proposed_change: Prototype a provenance-first distance assessment that prominently labels registered-address and straight-line limits, and exposes missing-geocode reasons
improvement.expected_benefit: Reduce reviewer reconciliation work without misrepresenting distance as operational eligibility

blind_evaluation.acceptance_rule: Independent reviewers compare the proposed output to baseline using identical blinded cases; record time/error and require all source-failure cases to remain non-chargeable.

customer_job.persona: Vendor-onboarding workflow designer evaluating registration age as one of several review signals
customer_job.trigger: A newly submitted vendor domain needs review during a broader company identity process
customer_job.success_action: Use authoritative registration age with clear caveats as part of a broader human-review workflow
customer_job.consequence_of_failure: A single cheap age signal is overinterpreted as vendor safety and consumes more settlement fees than it earns

comparator.method: Direct free authoritative registry RDAP lookup within an existing vendor identity-check workflow

improvement.proposed_change: Test including domain-age evidence inside an existing composite vendor review instead of marketing it as a standalone paid verdict
improvement.expected_benefit: Preserve useful evidence while reducing fragmented paid calls and overclaiming standalone value

blind_evaluation.acceptance_rule: Compare identical synthetic vendor-review workflows, measure paid calls and reviewer accuracy, and forbid independent safety conclusions from domain age alone.
